description:
Get an influencer's track record. `view` picks one of three records:

        accountability (default) — did their calls precede the move (Predictor)
          or react to it (Reactor)? Hit rate and track record.
        accuracy — did their price calls come true? Hit rate over 30/90/180 days
          at 24h, 7d and 30d, with the Wilson lower bound and excess over BTC.
        calls — the receipts: each call's post excerpt and link, entry price, and
          what happened after 24h/7d/30d. `horizon_hours` (24, 168, 720) picks
          which outcome the list is sorted and filtered on.

        One request per call. `influencer_id` is a creator id or username.
name: get_influencer_ledger
title: Influencer ledger · Track record
